title: What Is a Seed Phrase? The Secret Words That Control Your Crypto
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. A seed phrase is a list of words that can restore a crypto wallet, so keep it private and offline. Sources: Ethereum.org, Investopedia. AI-generated voice. Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: 12 WORDS, ONE KEY
scenes.narration: A short list of random words can control a whole crypto wallet. What exactly is a seed phrase?

scenes.head: WHAT IT IS
scenes.narration: A seed phrase is usually twelve or twenty four words. It lets you restore your wallet on a new device if your old one is lost.

scenes.head: WHY IT MATTERS
scenes.sub: ANYONE WITH IT HAS FULL ACCESS
scenes.narration: Anyone who has your seed phrase can take control of your wallet. There is usually no reset button and no support desk to undo it.

scenes.head: COMMON MISTAKES
scenes.narration: Common mistakes include taking a photo, saving it in cloud notes, or sending it in a chat. Those copies can be stolen.

scenes.head: SAFER HABITS
scenes.narration: Many guides suggest writing it on paper, storing it offline in a safe place, and never typing it into a website.

scenes.head: RED FLAG
scenes.narration: If anyone asks for your seed phrase, even someone claiming to be support, treat it as a scam warning sign.
